shortDescription: Configures a IIS Web site binding

options.name: certificate_hash
options.description: Certificate hash (thumbprint) for the SSL binding. The certificate hash is the unique identifier for the certificate.

options.name: certificate_store_name
options.description: Name of the certificate store where the certificate for the binding is located.

options.name: host_header
options.description: The host header to bind to / use for the new site. If you are creating/removing a catch-all binding, omit this parameter rather than defining it as '*'.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP address to bind to / use for the new site.

options.name: port
options.description: The port to bind to / use for the new site.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol to be used for the Web binding (usually HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP).

options.name: ssl_flags
options.description: This parameter is only valid on Server 2012 and newer. Primarily used for enabling and disabling server name indication (SNI). Set to C(0) to disable SNI. Set to C(1) to enable SNI.
